messages:
alex: Hey team :wave: Quick async check — we're about to merge the pricing/packaging change into main. Need owners/ok on metering adapter, billing rounding, quota limits, and contract clauses. TL;DR: rollout target Tue 03/31. Who can own what?

maria: I'll own metering adapter + SDK surface. Plan to open PR today, will add migration notes.

sam: I'll take billing rounding and ratecard mapping. Need clarification: do we round per-invoice line or at aggregator? cc @legal_sarah

legal_sarah: For contracts, we need to ensure the 'committed units' definition aligns with quota semantics. I'll review clause 4.2 and 7.1 — expect comments by EOD.

jin: I can handle quota enforcement side (rate-limiter + token bucket). Quick Q: are we capping per-customer per-minute or per-token?

alex: Per-customer per-minute cap for now; token-based billing still per-token. We'll add per-call token ceiling later.

sam: OK I'll implement rounding at invoice aggregation level then. Will add tests.

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/packaging/pull/542 — contains adapter change + changelog. Can reviewers pls look? @jin @sam

jin: Looking now, will leave review comments on the rate-limit hook. found one nit around K/V cache key.

ops-bot: deploy-check — staging tests passed (metrics, ingest) — build 2026.03.15-88.

maria: Heads up: SDK bump will be needed (v0.9.4 -> v0.10.0). Will include migration snippet in PR:
```
// old
client.generate({ model: 'r1' })
// new
client.generate({ model: 'r1', billingTag: 'new-pricing' })
```

sam: I'll queue a billing feature-flag: `pricing_v2` for canary. Want 10% traffic for first 24h.

alex: Sounds good. Final ask: add a short checklist in the PR description with owners for each bullet (metering, billing, quota, legal). I'll merge once checkboxes done + green CI.

legal_sarah: Added comment with suggested contract text: "CommittedUnits" means metered units charged under the customer's plan; rounding applies at invoice aggregation.

maria: Checkbox updated. tagging: metering=@maria, billing=@sam, quota=@jin, legal=@legal_sarah

jin: Confirmed - will push quota fix (rate-limit edge case) in next 30m.

sam: Will prepare billing migration script and dry-run on staging after jin's change.

alex: Great — ping here when PR merged. Thanks all :tada:
